summary: Completed requested local functional completion checks for remaining payments/email scope. Added persistent backend regression coverage for backup restore exactness, payment CRUD impact on overdue/reports/ledger, end-to-end /api/email/invoice route->local SMTP transport with retry, and optional two-parallel-payment race correctness. Full backend suite in /root/shpg-mail-test-venv passed (45 passed, 4 skipped). Browser-driven receipt download was executed and downloaded PDFs were parsed successfully via local pypdf. UI tenant-switch/retry-email checks were attempted but not fully completed due 3 repeated Playwright flow failures during the same receipt/download script path (loop-prevention stop applied).

integration_issues.flow: Playwright end-to-end composite flow for receipt download + tenant-switch/retry checks
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete all UI assertions in one automated run after 3 repeated script failures in same flow path; stopped per loop-prevention rule. This is a test-run limitation, not a confirmed product defect.

action_items: Run a fresh isolated Playwright script ONLY for case (5) tenant switching + retry-email UI to produce final UI evidence (previous composite run stopped after 3 failures per guardrail).
Run one isolated Playwright script ONLY for invoice PDF download assertion to capture explicit evidence that invoice PDF keeps original total after multiple payments.
Optional code-hardening review: frontend/src/lib/api.js currently includes localhost hardcoded fallback/default values; this conflicts with strict env-only URL policy in testing guidelines.
critical_code_review_comments: backend payment/email route logic passed requested functional checks including route->SMTP transport and persistence semantics.
frontend/src/lib/api.js resolves localhost with hardcoded fallback URL; violates strict env-only configuration principle and can mask misconfiguration.
SMTP credentials were verified absent from API responses and from hermetic SQLite test DB artifacts in new route-level SMTP tests.
seed_data_creation: Created preview-only TEST_UI_RCP_* invoices during browser receipt flow; cleaned up all tracked TEST_UI_RCP_* and prior TEST_UI_PAY_750256 invoices/tenants via public API after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend completion cases now covered in test_payments_regression.py: backup restore exactness, overdue/report/ledger CRUD linkage, /api/email/invoice transport via aiosmtpd with retry, and two-parallel-payment correctness. Browser receipt download succeeded and files exist in /tmp (ShreeStayHomesPG_Receipt_*.pdf) with parsed text confirming required receipt fields. Composite Playwright flow failed 3 times before reaching tenant-switch assertions; stop condition applied.
rca of the issue: No product bug confirmed from backend scope. Remaining gap is evidence completeness for two UI-only checks caused by automation-flow fragility: first run failed on async download context usage, second run failed from weak binary PDF parsing strategy, third run failed from strict receipt-number regex extraction despite receipt text being present when parsed locally with pypdf. Mitigation: split UI checks into smaller independent scripts (receipt-only, invoice-pdf-only, tenant-switch-only) to avoid cascading aborts.
